label: PF Backlog 247
title: EPIC: M0 fail-closed execution (gate for unattended/autonomous runs)
body: No unattended/autonomous execution or multi-tenant exposure until approvals, verification/completion, run-bound provenance, transactional state, tool/API authorization and budget/model limits are fail-closed and the 11-scenario acceptance suite passes. Sources: audit M0 + workstreams 1-4 (+enforceable 5); docs/final_required_changes.md.
